caption:
Figure 4. The overview architecture of the proposed method. Given an LR image y, we first estimate the degradation kernel kˆ , and involve
it in the deep constrained least squares (DCLS) convolution in the feature domain. The deblurred features R(cid:98) are then concatenated with
primitive features G y to restore the clean HR image x through a dual-path attention network (DPAN).
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed final complete DCLS architecture and read source_context Section 3.3 around Eq15: different-channel smooth filters explicitly support the added second footer statement. Caption supports estimated kernel into feature-domain DCLS and combination of primitive/deblurred features. All original butterfly evidence, kernel, matrix, five groups, DPG/DPAB paths and legend remain exact, with no new scientific connectors. Prior added-fragment correction leaves original pixels untouched.
